episode.subject: ground pangolin
episode.title: Claws held clear
episode.body:
Walked across the hard ground with my front claws tucked up. A small stone shifted beneath one hind foot. Put a forefoot down, steadied myself, lifted it again.

Nobody saw. I checked.

Then I crossed the rest of the patch in that dignified, careful posture and immediately used the protected claws to dig open an ant tunnel. They were being saved for something much less delicate than walking.

originalBody:
Walked across the hard ground with my front claws tucked up. A small stone shifted beneath one hind foot. Put a forefoot down, steadied myself, lifted it again.

Nobody saw. I checked.

Then I crossed the rest of the patch in that dignified, careful posture and immediately used the protected claws to tear apart a mound. They were being saved for something much less delicate than walking.
revisionReason: Original phrasing implies extensive mound destruction; reviewer supports a small ant-feeding excavation. Original body preserved in this record and initial review.
